name: Next Generation STEM Internship (NGSI), Summer 2027
city: Oak Ridge, TN (on site, for East Tennessee students)
what_you_do: Work full time with ORNL scientists and engineers on a STEM project at the lab.
grades: Junior or senior in 2027 to 2028 (class of 2028 or 2029), or a 2026 or 2027 graduate not yet in a degree program
who_can_apply: U.S. citizens or permanent residents, at least 16 by the start date, with a 3.00 GPA or higher. You must be in good standing at a school or approved home school in Anderson, Blount, Campbell, Knox, Loudon, McMinn, Monroe, Morgan, Roane or Sevier County, Tennessee. Proof of health insurance is required.
duration: 7 to 11 weeks, June 7 to July 23, 2027, full time each week
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications are open through February 26, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply on Zintellect by Feb 26, 2027. A full application needs recommendations sent through Zintellect. Applications missing a recommendation by the deadline are not considered.
notes: You can miss up to five days without stipend. Only students from the ten listed Tennessee counties can apply.
